pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Nando bhagavato mātucchāputto abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko caturaṅgulomako bhagavato.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.4: addasaṃsu kho therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Nandaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.7: te upagate jānitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Nando sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāressatīti. bhagavato . . . ārocesuṃ. atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Nandaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.9: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Nanda sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāresīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.12: kathañ hi nāma tvaṃ Nanda sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāressasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.13: n' etaṃ Nanda appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārāpeyya atirekaṃ vā, chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:1.16: tatr' idaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ: dīghaso nava vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:2.1.6: dīghaso nava vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:2.2.14: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto dvenavuti pācittiyā dhammā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc92:2.2.21: parisuddh' etthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti.
